comment: Two of the four parameters, MODE and SUB_CUTOFF, have no ParamWidget and are set only from the menu; the census paramPos holds just the two knobs. The output gain chain is AUDIO_IN_GAIN 0.1 at :66, AUDIO_OUT_GAIN 10 at :67 and outLevel as the knob doubled at :161, so the knob at its default of 1.0 with the balance at 0.5 gives unity, the knob at halfway gives -6dB and full clockwise gives +6dB. The block length is AUDIO_BUFLEN 64 at :62. Quad_Decoder.cpp:255 writes the logic steering coefficient to the SUB output inside the QS_LOGIC_DECODE branch, which looks like leftover debugging; it is overwritten every sample at :299 and has no audible effect. The Bypass choice sets the sub filter corner to 20000Hz at :386 rather than switching the filter out. A fourth decoding mode, SQ Logic Decode, is present in the source but commented out of both the mode list and the menu.
